However, the alignment is penalized because the head lacks clear anatomical definition (muzzle/horns obscured/melted), making it a 'generic bison-like mass' rather than a fully detailed specimen. 4/10 checkpoints were positively verified; 5 were untestable due to pose/occlusion; 1 failed (horns/head structure).
